events.verdict: Siakam (TOR) establishes himself in a screening position in Ariza's (WAS) defensive path after the hand-off takes place and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Beal (WAS) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Green (TOR) maintains legal guarding position as body contact is made with Beal (WAS) along the sideline.
LLB shows Green (TOR) makes contact with Beal's (WAS) left arm during his upward shooting motion and affects his jump shot attempt.
Green (TOR) veers slightly into Ariza's (WAS) defensive path, but gives Ariza room to avoid contact, which Green absorbs as it is made.
Ibaka (TOR) sets the pick on Ariza (WAS), who is stationary, and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Leonard (TOR) slightly extends his left hand against Bryant's (WAS) front, but contact is marginal and does not affect his ability to defend.
Beal (WAS) makes marginal contact with Green (WAS) along the lane line during the inbound.
Lowry (TOR) makes marginal contact with Porter Jr. (WAS) at the start of his drive.
Porter Jr. (WAS) makes contact with his left elbow to Lowry's (TOR) front at the end of the drive, but it is marginal and does not affect his ability to defend.
Lowry (TOR) maintains legal guarding position as contact is made with Porter Jr. (WAS) after his gather.
Ibaka (TOR) sets the pick on Ariza (WAS) at the top of the perimeter and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Beal (WAS) is in the lane for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Ibaka (TOR) slightly extends his hands against Beal's (WAS) backside during rebounding, but the contact does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Ibaka (TOR) grabs Ariza's (WAS) arm and restricts his ability to maintain his defensive position.
Ariza (WAS) makes marginal contact with Leonard (TOR) that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.

[Observable in enhanced video] Green (WAS) receives the pass and gathers the ball on both feet. He then lifts his left foot, which establishes his right foot as his pivot. He then lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Leonard (TOR) makes contact with Satoransky (WAS) that is tactile in nature during the inbound.
Anunoby (TOR) legally contests Green's (WAS) jump shot attempt.

Ariza (WAS) briefly loses control of the ball as Ibaka (TOR) dislodges it from him as he is mid-air. He then legally returns to the floor and re-establishes control. An inadvertent whistle was blown and the ball was correctly awarded to WAS.
Lowry (TOR) and Siakam (TOR) make marginal contact with Ariza (WAS) at the start of the drive that does not affect his SQBR.

There is an inadvertent whistle on the play. After Ariza's (WAS) gathers the ball, it is tipped by Ibaka (TOR), therefore Ariza is allowed to regathers the ball on the play. After the discussion the ball is rewarded to Washington.
Green (TOR) reflexively places his arms around Bryant's (WAS) midsection after the hand-off and creates contact that is tactile in nature.
Lowry (TOR) makes marginal contact with Beal (WAS) after the release of his driving shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow through naturally.
Ibaka (TOR) and Bryant (WAS) engage and disengage during the inbound without affecting the other's ability to move freely.

Leonard (TOR) cleanly blocks Beal's (WAS) driving shot attempt prior to incidental contact being made with his arm. Additionally, the block occurs prior to any contact by Ibaka (TOR) as he contest the shot.
Bryant (WAS) sets the screen on Green (TOR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.

Porter Jr. (WAS) slightly extends his right elbow from the frame of his body as contact is made with Lowry (TOR) during the screen, but he keeps it collapsed upon impact and does not affect Lowry's ability to defend.
RLB shows Siakam (TOR) makes contact with Ariza's (WAS) right arm during his upward shooting motion and affects his jump shot attempt.
Ariza (WAS) reaches in from behind and makes contact with Leonard's (TOR) left arm after his gather.
[Observable in enhanced video] Bryant (WAS) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Ibaka (TOR) maintains legal guarding position as marginal contact is made with Bryant (WAS) after his gather.

Bryant (WAS) makes slight contact with Ibaka's (TOR) head during rebounding. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.

LLS shows Beal (WAS) makes contact with Leonard's (TOR) right arm during rebounding and causes him to briefly fumble the ball, while also giving him the opportunity to tie Leonard up. The contact and subsequent tie-up results in a jump ball, leading to a change of possession.
Ariza (WAS) makes marginal contact with Green (TOR) during the jump ball.

Lowry (WAS) makes slight contact with Satoransky's (WAS) face during rebounding. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
RLB shows that Satoransky (WAS) creates contact with Lowry (TOR) during rebounding that impedes his ability to retrieve the ball.
Lowry (TOR) maintains legal guarding position and absorbs contact as it is made with Beal (WAS) after his gather.
Ibaka (TOR) fully extends both hands against Satoransky's (WAS) backside and creates contact that dislodges him from his legally obtained rebounding position.
[Observable in enhanced video] Satoransky (WAS) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Lowry (TOR) initiates body contact with Porter Jr. (WAS) in the corner that affects his FOM.
[Observable in enhanced video] Bryant (WAS) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Lowry (TOR) cleanly dislodges Satoransky (WAS) of the ball during rebounding.
[Observable in enhanced video] Beal (WAS) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Siakam (TOR) makes contact with Beal's (WAS) head during the drive.
Ariza (WAS) maintains legal guarding position throughout Leonard's (TOR) drive and after his gather.
Bryant (WAS) makes contact with Lowry's (TOR) right arm after he has gathered the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Satoransky (WAS) slides his pivot foot after picking up his dribble.
Leonard (TOR) makes slight contact with Bryant's (WAS) arm during his upward shooting motion.
Satoransky (WAS) makes foot contact with the ball during the pass intended for Ibaka (TOR).
When the timeout is rewarded the count has exceed 5 seconds.
[Observable in enhanced video] Leonard's (TOR) left foot lands prior to his right foot, which establishes his left as his pivot. He then lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Ariza (WAS) makes contact with Leonard's (TOR) head at the beginning of his upward shooting motion.
LLB shows Beal (WAS) makes contact across Anunoby's (TOR) arm after he gains control of the rebound, causing him to lose control of the ball.
The timeout is awarded to WAS prior to the ball being deflected out of bounds.
Lowry (TOR) makes slight contact with Bryant (WAS) after the release of his shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow through naturally or ability to return safely to the floor.
Bryant (WAS) maintains legal guarding position and absorbs contact as it is made with Leonard (TOR) after his gather.
Leonard (TOR) makes clean contact with the ball during the inbound pass intended for Beal (WAS).
Bryant (WAS) sets the pick on Lowry (TOR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Beal (WAS) makes incidental body contact with Lowry (TOR) during rebounding.
Satoransky (WAS) dives to the floor and initiates body contact with Green (TOR) during rebounding.
Beal (WAS) makes incidental body contact with Lowry (TOR) as they each attempt to gain possession of the ball.
